question: Identify the antonym of "Vivacious"
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**, i.e. **Unattractive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Vivacious"** means full of life, energy, and enthusiasm; lively and animated in personality. (जीवंत, उत्साही)

 
 
• **Example:** She has a vivacious personality that lights up the room wherever she goes.
 

 
• **"Unattractive"** refers to something or someone lacking charm, appeal, or beauty; dull or unappealing. (अकर्षक)

 
 
• **Example:** The old building appeared unattractive due to its worn-out facade.
 

 
• Hence, the antonym of "Vivacious" is **"Unattractive"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**, i.e., **Unattractive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cheerful** (प्रसन्न): Happy and optimistic; showing joy or gladness.

 
 
• **Example:** He has a cheerful demeanor that makes everyone around him smile.
 
 

 
• **Lively** (जीवंत): Full of energy and enthusiasm; active and animated.

 
 
• **Example:** The lively children ran around the playground with excitement.
 
 

 
• **Bubbly** (उत्साही): Energetic and cheerful in a way that is charming and contagious.

 
 
• **Example:** Her bubbly personality makes her a favorite at social gatherings.
